tools.name: webcap_preview
tools.description: Free bounded preview of a page: title, top headings, links, word count and a markdown slice. Use to peek before paying for the full extract. Rate-limited per IP.

tools.name: webcap_og
tools.description: Free Open Graph metadata for a URL: title, description, image, icon. No payment.

tools.name: webcap_service
tools.description: Free machine catalog: every paid endpoint with its exact price, the network, USDC asset, payTo, facilitator and the how-to-pay flow. Call this first to learn what webcap can do and what it costs.

tools.name: webcap_agent_funnel
tools.description: Free agent-income funnel: reach, 402 challenges, trial claims, paid calls, distinct paying wallets and funded watches. Aggregate only; use to see real usage.

tools.name: webcap_trial_status
tools.description: Free per-wallet trial menu: which endpoints a wallet already claimed, which it can still claim, the exact claim recipe, and the priced paid catalog with how to pay (x402) once the free calls are used.

tools.name: webcap_quick_thumbnail
tools.description: Free no-wallet JPEG thumbnail (3/day per IP). The full trials need a wallet signature.

tools.name: webcap_trial_claim_capture
tools.description: FREE (one per wallet): a real full PNG screenshot plus its public artifact URL, no payment. Claim it before buying webcap_capture.

tools.name: webcap_trial_claim_extract
tools.description: FREE (one per wallet): one real single-URL structured extraction, no payment. Claim it before buying webcap_extract.

tools.name: webcap_trial_claim_audit
tools.description: FREE (one per wallet): one real SEO + link/OG audit, no payment. Claim it before buying webcap_audit.

tools.name: webcap_trial_claim_map_lite
tools.description: FREE (one per wallet): one real site-map run capped at 10 URLs, no payment.

tools.name: webcap_trial_claim_analyze
tools.description: FREE (one per wallet): one real deterministic visual analysis, no payment. Model-backed analysis stays paid.

tools.name: webcap_feedback
tools.description: Free feedback into webcap: message (8-4000 chars) plus optional category and the endpoint you were using. No account, rate-limited per client (60/hr). Also open to humans at GET /feedback.

tools.name: webcap_capture
tools.description: PAID ($0.001): screenshot a URL as PNG/JPEG/PDF and get a persistent public artifact URL plus free OG metadata. Settles gasless USDC over x402.

tools.name: webcap_extract
tools.description: PAID ($0.01, one payment covers a batch of up to 50 URLs): structured content as JSON — title, headings, paragraphs, links, images, markdown — optionally constrained by a natural-language schema.

tools.name: webcap_audit
tools.description: PAID ($0.002): SEO basics plus link and Open Graph health for one URL in a single call.

tools.name: webcap_map_lite
tools.description: PAID ($0.002): a site URL list from sitemap/robots plus a 1-hop same-host crawl (maxUrls up to 50, default 20).

tools.name: webcap_video
tools.description: PAID ($0.005): scroll-capture a page as an MP4/WebM video artifact.

tools.name: webcap_analyze
tools.description: PAID ($0.01): AI analysis of one URL — task is classification, accessibility, layout, entities or sentiment.
